title: TSAI Reputation Methodology
description: An immutable, versioned definition of a Trust Authority reputation score methodology.

id.description: Versioned HTTPS identifier; MUST equal the mtd value in the reputation signal

minimum.description: Inclusive minimum for a normalised TSAI score

maximum.description: Inclusive maximum for a normalised TSAI score

direction.description: Higher values represent the more favourable result under the methodology

semantics.description: Meaning of the score and what it does and does not assert

calculation.description: How observations are transformed into the score

outcomes.description: How observed outcomes are defined and classified

minimumHistory.description: Minimum evidence needed before a score is issued

insufficientHistory.description: How insufficient evidence affects issuance and scoring

qualityControls.description: Optional controls for fraud, bias, disputes, and data quality
